seed.rationale: Fired clay and the inside of a brick oven. Chosen by the client before the project began, so it is locked and the rest of the palette is built around it.
seed.name: Kiln Terracotta

secondary.rationale: Complement of the terracotta, used sparingly for links and focus states. The complement rule is low-confidence evidence; it was kept because it reads clearly against the warm seed.
secondary.name: Harbour Teal

tertiary.rationale: Named after the street. Used for success states and the seasonal menu.
tertiary.name: Fern Green

accepted.light|outline|surface|non-text: Softer outline for card borders and dividers on the menu pages. These are decorative, so WCAG 1.4.11 does not require 3:1. Do not use this color for form field borders or focus rings; use the primary role for those.
